pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo āsandimpi pallaṅkampi paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo āsandimpi pallaṅkampi paribhuñjissanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo āsandimpi pallaṅkampi paribhuñjissantī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo āsandimpi pallaṅkampi paribhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo āsandimpi pallaṅkampi paribhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.14.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī āsandiṃ vā pallaṅkaṃ vā paribhuñjeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:2.1.10: tasmiṃ abhinisīdati vā abhinipajjati vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
